verified_facts.text: The hotel is in Gangnam, near the COEX Convention center.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perfectly located in the Gangnam near the COEX Convention

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a 1-minute walk from Exit 1 of Samseong Station.
verified_facts.excerpt: Park Hyatt Seoul is a 1-minute walk from Exit 1 of Samseong Station.

verified_facts.text: Cultural sites such as Bongeun temple, art galleries, shopping, outdoor parks and paths along the Han River are within easy reach.
verified_facts.excerpt: You’re within easy reach of cultural sites such as Bongeun temple, along with art galleries, shopping, outdoor parks and paths along the Han River.

verified_facts.text: The granite-lined indoor swimming pool is designed in an infinity pool style, with natural light through floor-to-ceiling windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: The granite-lined indoor swimming pool at Park Hyatt Seoul is designed in an infinity pool style, offering a unique atmosphere each hour as natural sunlight streams through the floor-to-ceiling windows.

verified_facts.text: Ocelas Spa at Park Club has three private treatment rooms and a citrus bar serving Korean-inspired refreshments, with views across central Gangnam.
verified_facts.excerpt: Three private treatment rooms offer undisturbed rest and relaxation, while a citrus bar serves a selection of Korean-inspired refreshments.

verified_facts.text: Cornerstone, on the 2nd floor, is the hotel's Italian restaurant.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the 2nd floor, our main restaurant, Cornerstone, offers authentic Italian dishes

verified_facts.text: Cornerstone offers a gift selection from Pierre Herme Paris, including macarons and chocolates.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests may also discover a gift selection from Pierre Hermé Paris, including macarons and chocolates, at Cornerstone.

verified_facts.text: The Lounge, on the 24th floor with panoramic city views, serves contemporary Korean cuisine with seasonal ingredients and French cooking techniques, plus traditional teas and signature afternoon tea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Alongside a premium collection of traditional teas and signature afternoon tea, The Lounge presents contemporary dining that brings together Korean cuisine made with seasonal ingredients, French cooking techniques, and delicate plating.

verified_facts.text: The Timber House is a whisky and cocktail bar reached through a hidden passageway that reinterprets Korean tradition through a contemporary lens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Reached through a hidden passageway, The Timber House is a premium whisky and cocktail bar that reinterprets the beauty of Korean tradition through a contemporary lens.

verified_facts.text: The Timber House has live performances every evening.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests can also enjoy live performances every evening,

verified_facts.text: Room service is available 24 hours a day, with mobile ordering by QR code.
verified_facts.excerpt: Room Service is available 24 hours a day

verified_facts.text: On request, the VIB (very important baby) program for infants under 3 includes a children's menu and homemade baby food from the chefs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Upon request, the VIB (very important baby) program is available for infants under 3 years of age, featuring a specially prepared children’s menu and homemade baby food crafted with care by our chefs.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers stroller and baby bed rentals and babysitting services.
verified_facts.excerpt: we also provide Hartan stroller and Daiichi baby bed rentals, as well as babysitting services.

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms have spa-inspired rain showers and spacious bathtubs, and rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with city views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sleek designed bathrooms appointed with spa-inspired rain showers and spacious bathtubs will make your stay extraordinary.

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite is on the top floor, with panoramic city views and Korean accents.
verified_facts.excerpt: A 160-square-meter suite on the top floor, offering panoramic city views and curated luxury with Korean accents.

verified_facts.text: Park Suites include Le Labo bath amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Le Labo bath amenities

verified_facts.text: Guests ascend to the lobby on the 24th floor, which has high ceilings, contemporary Korean art and views of Gangnam.
verified_facts.excerpt: It's only after ascending to the lobby on the 24th floor that the hotel experience opens up: The ceilings are high, the room is full of air and light (as well as some eye-catching contemporary Korean art)

verified_facts.text: The hotel was the first hotel from the Japanese architecture firm Super Potato.
verified_facts.excerpt: This was the first hotel from the Japanese architecture firm Super Potato

verified_facts.text: Bedrooms use pale oak, and bathrooms use rough Japanese stone and heavy marble.
verified_facts.excerpt: The dominant materials are acres of pale oak in the bedrooms and rough Japanese stone and heavy marble in the bathrooms.

verified_facts.text: A separate set of elevators runs from street level to the lobby, and another set goes to the rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: it is slightly confusing to have one set that goes between street level and the top-level lounge and another that goes to the rooms

verified_facts.text: Valet parking is offered to all guests and a parking fee applies to all vehicles.
verified_facts.excerpt: Park Hyatt Seoul offers valet parking service to all guests. A parking fee applies to all vehicles using this service.

verified_facts.text: Wi-Fi is free.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Wi-fi is free and the quality is excellent.
